Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Our two top choices for everyday wear are the Cabana Shift Dress and the Tunic Dress.
The Cabana Shift Dress ($138) offers a classic, tailored boat neck silhouette with functional front pockets. It is lightweight, wrinkle-resistant, and seamlessly moves from casual outings to the beach.
The Tunic Dress ($138–$144) features a relaxed, easy fit with split-neck detailing, making it ideal for a quick, pull-on style.
